name: Welcome!
summary: This errand introduces adventurers carrying a special gift voucher to Yori Crackhelm in Kharanos. In exchange for the token, Crackhelm presents the traveler with an uncommon pet companion to accompany them across Dun Morogh and beyond.

sections.title: A Welcoming Gesture
sections.body: Travelers braving the frozen hills of Dun Morogh may find themselves in possession of a curious voucher destined for Kharanos. This mountain settlement, bustling with forge smoke and dwarven trade, serves as an early crossroads for newly arrived heroes stepping out from Coldridge Valley.

sections.title: A Loyal Companion
sections.body: Waiting in town is Yori Crackhelm, an innkeeper and merchant who gladly trades the voucher for a unique traveling companion. For novice wanderers facing troggs, frost wolves, and the bitter mountain chill, having a small creature by their side is a heartening way to begin a life of adventure.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: why do i have this voucher
faq.answer: The quest directs a traveler holding a Kharanos Gift Voucher to deliver it to Yori Crackhelm in Kharanos in exchange for an exclusive companion pet.
Yori Crackhelm is a dwarf found in Kharanos who greets adventurers bearing special gift vouchers and awards them with their chosen companion.

faq.q: Where does this voucher come from?
aliases: how did i get the voucher
faq.answer: The voucher is bestowed upon adventurers who entered Azeroth via the original World of Warcraft Collector's Edition as a commemorative reward.
Kharanos is the primary town in central Dun Morogh, situated along the snowy road just east of the mountain pass exiting Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: Can members of the Horde complete this quest?
aliases: can horde turn in at kharanos
faq.answer: No. Yori Crackhelm resides in an Alliance-aligned settlement in the heart of dwarf territory, making this specific turn-in exclusive to Alliance adventurers.

faq.q: Does this companion fight beside you in battle?
faq.answer: No. The companion awarded by Yori Crackhelm is a non-combat pet, meant strictly as a friendly and decorative follower on your travels.

angles.text: Taking your first steps outside of Coldridge Valley brings you straight to Kharanos, where local townsfolk like Yori Crackhelm warmly greet returning mountaineers.
For gnomish refugees living among the snow drifts of Dun Morogh, receiving a friendly companion upon reaching Kharanos brings a cheerful moment of solace.
Alliance recruits passing through Dun Morogh find friendly support from local merchants and innkeepers eager to celebrate their arrival.
